input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit/inspection right binding us (Section 23 contains no operative records or assurance obligation, and no other verification or monitoring right appears in the document). Section 22.1 meets the preferred position on every material term: audits limited to once in any twelve-month period, at least thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, and by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality. Section 22.2 puts audit costs on Vendor unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding five percent, and expressly bars Vendor and its auditor from direct access to Customer systems, Customer Data unrelated to usage, privileged material, and other suppliers' confidential information. Section 22.3 adds further protections (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the final report, and payment of a shortfall resolving the issue). No redline required.
